headline: President Prabowo Subianto Hosts Ten Former Police Chiefs In Hambalang
seoTitle: Prabowo Subianto Meets Ten Former Police Chiefs
metaDescription: President Prabowo Subianto held a meeting with ten former National Police Chiefs at his residence in Hambalang to discuss current national issues.
aiSummaryBullets: President Prabowo Subianto held a formal meeting with ten former chiefs of the Indonesian National Police.
The session took place at the President's residence in Hambalang and included discussions on current national affairs.
Participants included Minister of Home Affairs Tito Karnavian, though former police chief Idham Azis was not among those present.
aiContextParagraph: President Prabowo Subianto convened with a group of ten former Indonesian National Police (Kapolri) chiefs at his residence in Hambalang on November 8, 2026. The meeting, described as a formal networking and discussion session, aimed to foster dialogue across generations of police leadership. Among those attending the event was the current Minister of Home Affairs, Tito Karnavian, who participated alongside other retired police officials. Reports confirmed that while the gathering brought together various former leaders of the institution, former chief Idham Azis was not recorded as being in attendance. The meeting served as a forum for the President and the former police leaders to exchange views on various contemporary issues facing the country. This interaction followed recent recognition of current police leadership efforts in community policing reform, highlighting a focus on the role and organizational development of the Indonesian National Police.
whyItIsViral: The story gained traction across six independent media outlets in a short timeframe, resulting in a high viral activity score due to the significant gathering of high-ranking former security officials.
